title: 非常通報ポール
description: 公園や駅前、駐車場に立つ、非常時の通報用ポールです。コンクリート基礎、赤い円柱の本体と反射帯、頭部の青い点灯ビーコン（発光材質）、ステンレスの通話パネルと黄色い呼出しボタン、スピーカーの穴、カメラドーム、無地の案内板を造形しています。案内文・電話番号などの文字や記号、通話・録画などの機能は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.440 × 1.980 × 0.440 m、3,092三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An emergency call pillar for parks, station plazas and car parks. It models the concrete footing, red cylindrical body with reflective bands, a lit blue beacon on top (emissive material), a stainless call panel with a yellow call button, speaker slots, a camera dome and a blank instruction plate. Instructions, phone numbers and other lettering or symbols, and calling or recording functions are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.440 × 1.980 × 0.440 m; 3,092 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
